artifacts.summary: Confirms the git-ls-files enumeration fix for check_undeclared_scripts() in agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/check-extension-docs.sh, empirically verified against the live repo across all extensions with zero regressions.

memory_candidates.content: In check-extension-docs.sh, git -C "$REPO_ROOT" ls-files <pathspec> always returns REPO_ROOT-relative paths regardless of whether <pathspec> itself is absolute or relative to cwd. This differs from `find`, whose output mirrors whatever form its search-root argument took. When replacing a `find`-based enumeration with a `git ls-files`-based one in this script, any downstream prefix-strip logic (e.g. rel_path="${script_file#\"$ext_path_norm\"/scripts/}") must be re-derived against the REPO_ROOT-relative form of the prefix, not copied unchanged -- a naive copy silently degrades to matching nothing.
